rows: PART Q SECURITY Unauthorised access Q1 Reasonable provision must be made to resist unauthorised access to— (a) any dwelling; and (b) any part of a building from which access can be gained to a flat within the building.
Requirement Q1 applies only in relation to new dwellings.
sentences: Requirement Q1: Unauthorised access: under Part Q Security, Unauthorised access, Q1, reasonable provision must be made to resist unauthorised access to (a) any dwelling; and (b) any part of a building from which access can be gained to a flat within the building, and the limits on application are that Requirement Q1 applies only in relation to new dwellings.
